label: Agent crew
features: A crew with a head pal
Every project is a pal with its own topics. A head pal relays your asks to the right pal and reports back.
Move a topic from Claude Code to Codex and back with a brief, so the next agent picks up where the last stopped.
Merges, pushes and instruction edits are held until you approve them, and each helper gets a trust level you set.
